name: HCM IV Acquisition Corp. Class A Ordinary Share
summary: HCM IV Acquisition Corp. functions as a Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC). Its core mission is to execute a business combination with one or more existing operating entities. This could encompass various types of transactions, such as a merger, asset acquisition, share exchange, reorganization, or other similar corporate integrations. The company was founded on September 5, 2025, and maintains its principal executive offices in Stamford, CT.
